objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed policy or guideline document in DHC VISION, including created, edited, released, distributed, versioned, archived, translated, and evaluated documents.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type selected for a document; examples include policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, additional info, and attachment.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Level used to differentiate documents in the document pyramid.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties for relevant companies.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties for areas of validity.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document type abbreviation included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client, consecutive, 4-digit number per document type included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title included in the document name.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document and is managed through versioning.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document and indicates workflow or lifecycle state.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning reader authorizations via User Group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning the registered author and personal authorizations.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning reviewers and personal authorizations.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning releasers and personal authorizations.

attributes.name: releaser_incl._translation
attributes.description: Attribute for assigning releasers including translation.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which document validity starts.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate the valid-until date.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents are retained.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Original language version required for translation.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: Language in which an authorized reader views the released language version.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specifies in which clients a document is visible in a multi-client system.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document is created in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited with the implemented editing client.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: The approval workflow releases a document after creator, review, and release steps.

o2o.description: One or more document templates can be defined for each document type and selected when creating new objects.

o2e.description: The event attaches a new information object when creating the document.
